referenced_evidence.relevance: Positive control: HTTP fingerprint discrimination 0.833 on real Flask/JWT endpoints
Orthogonality confirmed at delta=0.15 under stochastic mock (r=0.046, CI upper 0.135)
Parent handoff: three-way decision (close C-PRODUCT-ECON / provision LLM / redirect to C-FRESHNESS)

execution_phases: Phase 1: Auth-state discrimination (4 auth states x 10 samples = 40 requests)
Phase 3: Null FP rate (4 auth states x 10 samples = 40 requests, no drift/noise)
Phase 4: Co-occurring conditions (12 drift x noise combinations x 60 samples = 720 requests)
Phase 5: Noise-only conditions (4 noise types x 60 samples = 240 requests)
Phase 6: Behavioral TP (3 drift types x 60 samples = 180 requests)
Phase 7: Orthogonality test (TOST on 720 paired behavioral/structural samples)
Phase 8: Noise FP rate (computed from Phase 5 data)
measurement_notes: Server started as daemon thread via wsgiref.simple_server (single-process, synchronous)
All requests sequential from main thread (no concurrency)
JWT tokens generated per-request with deterministic seed=42
Behavioral score computed client-side from response body JSON
